## Edge Functions

`POST create_ticket(workspace_id, subject, priority?, customer_id?)`
Create a ticket and notify the assignee.

`POST search_articles(workspace_id, query)`
Semantic search over the knowledge base.

## Realtime

Publication: `public.tickets`, `public.ticket_comments`, `public.notifications`
- `ticket_updated` ← `public.tickets` (audience: workspace_members)
- `notification_created` ← `public.notifications` (audience: workspace_members)

## Storage

- `avatars` — public · image/png, image/jpeg · max 2 MB
- `ticket_attachments` — private · application/pdf, image/png, text/plain · max 25 MB
